comments.body:
## Investigation evidence (2026-11-01)

**Code path (origin/main 504b85c324f).**
- `_mcp_tool_specs.py`: `transition_ticket` -> `library="transition"`, in-process. `_lib_writes.transition` -> `transition_compute` -> `transition_close.close_ticket` -> `close_precheck._completion_precheck`. The "rebar transition failed (exit 1)" prefix is produced by the library itself, not a subprocess.
- `_completion_precheck` calls `capture_completion_ticket_view(..., fetch=False)`, which returns `(None, None)` unless `verify.completion_pinned_ticket_view` is true (default false, never set in `rebar.toml`, not set in `infra/compose` or `autodeploy.sh`). With no view, `txn.ensure_ac_boxes_checked(ticket_id, tracker)` reduces `<tracker>/<id>` from the clone's files.
- No call on the close path fetches. Read tools (`_reads.show_ticket`, `_lib_gates.check_ac`) call `reads.ensure_fresh(tracker)`, throttled by `/tmp/.ticket-sync-<md5>` to one attempt per 60 s.
- `gates.check_ac_compute` passes when `_count_ac_reset(...) >= 1`; it counts criteria lines and does not read checkbox state, so `check_ac: pass, 6 criteria` holds for a ticket with 6 unticked boxes.

**Pinned view not in use on the server.** 0 of the 400 most recent `COMPLETION_VERDICT` events in the store carry `completion_read_basis`. Both MCP verdicts on `fb5f` (21:42 and 21:53 PDT, env `eea68b7f`) record `material_basis: unpinned_completion_inputs`.

**Incident timeline (`fb5f`, 2026-10-31 PDT, from origin/tickets).** EDIT event 21:57:39 (local CLI), commit 661ad2e578e 21:58:05; local COMPLETION_VERDICT 22:02:17, STATUS closed 22:02:54. The MCP refusals fell between 21:58 and 22:02.

**Reproduction (real git, two clones of one bare origin, `rebar.transition(repo_root=B)`, `verify_completion` stubbed, no LLM).**
- B's throttle marker stamped fresh, A ticks both boxes and pushes, B closes -> `Error: ticket ... has unchecked Acceptance Criteria items: - [ ] first done - [ ] second done`.
- Same setup, but the marker is removed and `rebar.show_ticket(repo_root=B)` runs first -> show reports 0 unticked, B HEAD equals origin, close succeeds.

So the close judges whatever the clone last synced. Unverified: why the incident's refusals continued after the MCP `show_ticket` had observed the edit; that ordering did not reproduce in-process, and server logs were not read.

## Landed

Gerrit change 3208 merged as 74e333ef1d6 (2026-11-01 07:08 PST): LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 on patch set 2 (a13531cdd2c), 0 unresolved comments.

**AC1 (source + hypotheses).** See the investigation comment: `transition_ticket` runs `rebar.transition` in-process on the same `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` clone (hypothesis 1 refuted); the pinned view is off on the server (0 of 400 recent verdicts carry `completion_read_basis`), so the precheck reduced the clone's files directly (hypothesis 2 refuted as stated). Cause: nothing on the close path fetched; only throttled read tools did.

**Fix.** `transition_close._refresh_close_material` calls `reads.ensure_fresh(tracker, force=True)` at the top of the close branch of `close_ticket`, before the open-child scan and outside the write lock; skipped for forced closes and `idea` rejections. Patch set 1 placed it after the open-child scan; the LLM-Review advisory noted the scan read stale state, so patch set 2 moved it ahead of the scan. `docs/concurrency.md` documents it in the gate-freshness and read-freshness sections.

**AC2-AC4 (tests).** `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_close_fresh_ac_material.py`, two clones of one bare origin, B's throttle marker fresh, `verify_completion` stubbed (no LLM):
- Before the fix: `2 failed, 3 passed` — `test_close_observes_boxes_ticked_in_another_clone` (refused with the stale `- [ ] first done / - [ ] second done`) and `test_close_refuses_a_box_unticked_in_another_clone` (closed on stale ticks).
- After the fix: all 6 pass (adds the idea-rejection no-fetch test), plus `test_sync_pull_off_keeps_the_close_local` (0 fetches), `test_unreachable_origin_closes_on_local_state`, `test_forced_close_does_not_fetch`.

**AC5.** Locally: `make lint` exit 0, `make typecheck` "Success: no issues found in 746 source files"; targeted runs 578 passed (tests/interfaces/lifecycle), 803 passed (modules referencing the close path / freshness), 451 passed 9 skipped (tests/interfaces/store), 1152 passed (close/transition/fresh/upkeep selection), integration tier 195 passed. Patch set 1 got Verified -1 from one policy test (`test_no_test_clones_an_unpinned_bare_repository`: the new test created its bare origin by hand); fixed with `init_bare_remote`. Patch set 2: Verified +1.

No live LLM gate run was used for reproduction. LLM gate runs in this session: 1 `review-plan` (PASS, signed) and the close's completion verification.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Closing `fb5f-54fd-96cc-4105` through MCP `transition_ticket` was refused with
"has unchecked Acceptance Criteria items", quoting the pre-edit description, while
MCP `show_ticket` already returned the edited description (0 `- [ ]`, `updated_at`
equal to the EDIT event). The boxes were ticked from a different clone (a local
worktree) and pushed. The same close then succeeded through the local CLI. An
operator following the refusal has nothing left to do except `--force`.

## Findings (code path, evidence in comments)

- `transition_ticket` is in-process: the MCP spec maps it to the library
  `rebar.transition` -> `transition_compute` -> `transition_close.close_ticket`.
  It reads the same `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` clone as the read tools. Hypothesis 1 (a
  subprocess on a second clone) is refuted.
- The deployed server does not run the pinned view: 0 of the 400 most recent
  COMPLETION_VERDICT events carry `completion_read_basis`, and the MCP verdicts on
  `fb5f` record `material_basis: unpinned_completion_inputs`. So hypothesis 2 is
  refuted as stated; with the view off, `close_precheck` passes no state and
  `txn.ensure_ac_boxes_checked` reduces the ticket from the server clone's files.
- The defect: nothing on the close path fetches. `close_ticket` and
  `_completion_precheck` read ticket type, plan-review material, AC boxes and the
  landing scan from whatever the clone holds. Only read tools call
  `reads.ensure_fresh`, throttled to one fetch per 60 s by a shared marker, so a
  close sees another clone's edit only if some read happened to reconverge first.
- `check_ac` is not evidence of ticked boxes: `check_ac_compute` counts criteria
  lines (`criteria_count >= 1` passes) and never inspects `[x]`/`[ ]`.
- Prior intent: ticket `glandulous-minor-aurochs` decided "gate material reads force
  one fetch; other reads keep the 60 s throttle" (`ensure_fresh(force=True)`,
  best-effort, honors `sync.pull=off`). Ticket `thin-broadish-basenji` set the close
  path to read the tracker "current-at-close". This applies both to the close.

Unverified: why one incident retry window lasted minutes rather than 60 s; the
server's logs were not inspected. The fix does not depend on it.

## Approach

Add `_refresh_close_material(tracker, force_close)` in
`src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py` and call it at the top of the close
branch of `close_ticket` (target `closed`, source not `idea`), before the first
`reduce_ticket`. Unforced closes run `reads.ensure_fresh(tracker, force=True)`
once: one best-effort fetch + reconverge that skips only the 60 s age check, keeps
the `sync.pull=off`, `--no-pull` and local-read-context opt-outs, writes the marker
and swallows every failure (an unreachable origin closes on local state exactly as
today). Forced closes skip it: they bypass every gate that reads this material.
It runs outside the write lock, as the existing close checks do, so no fetch runs
under the lock. Every later read in the close (type, plan-review recheck, AC
boxes, attested items, landing scan, the pinned view's HEAD capture when that
experiment is on) then sees the synced clone. No new config, env var or flag.

Document in `docs/concurrency.md` (read-freshness policy) that gate material
reads, now including an unforced close, force one fetch past the throttle.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py`: the helper and its single call.
- `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_close_fresh_ac_material.py`: new tests.
- `docs/concurrency.md`: one paragraph in the read-freshness policy.

Out of scope: claim-time currency (`fabulous-avian-hoverfly`), `check_ac`
semantics, enabling the pinned view.

## Testing

Two clones of one bare `tickets` origin: clone A (editor) and clone B (the
"server", `require_completion_verification_for_close = true`). The throttle marker
for B is stamped fresh, as on a busy server. `rebar.llm.verify_completion` is
stubbed, so no LLM runs. Close goes through `rebar.transition(repo_root=B)`, the
entry point MCP `transition_ticket` calls.

1. Satisfied: A ticks every box and pushes; B closes. Before the fix B refuses
   with the stale unchecked items (reproduced); after, it closes.
2. Unsatisfied: B already holds a ticked description; A unticks one box and pushes;
   B's close is refused naming that item, matching a fresh `show_ticket`. Before
   the fix B closes on the stale ticks.
3. Opt-out: with `REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off`, the close makes no fetch (fetch spy count
   0) and judges local state.
4. Unreachable origin: remote URL points nowhere; the close does not raise from
   the fetch and judges local state (refused on stale items).
5. Forced close: no fetch attempted.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The source `transition_ticket`'s AC precheck reads is identified, and
      which of the 2 hypotheses holds is stated with evidence from the code
      path, not inference from the error string.
- [x] A regression test fails before the fix and passes after: a close through
      `rebar.transition` (the entry point MCP `transition_ticket` uses), on a clone
      whose throttle marker is fresh, observes a description edit pushed from
      another clone.
- [x] For the same ticket at the same moment, the close precheck and a fresh
      `show_ticket` agree on the AC boxes, for both a satisfied and an
      unsatisfied ticket (tests 1 and 2).
- [x] The forced fetch honors `sync.pull=off`, survives an unreachable origin,
      and is skipped on a forced close (tests 3-5).
- [x] Targeted tests, `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass locally, and the
      change has `Verified +1` in Gerrit (the CI run of the `make test` selection).

document that an unforced close forces one fetch past the read throttle
